propositions: The production review bot must be cut over from direct Anthropic API to Bedrock inference profiles with a per-class model split (frontier=opus, standard/trivial=sonnet/haiku)
The Bedrock provider package must be installed in the review-bot container via --extra bedrock in the uv sync command
The kill switch must restore the Anthropic path by deleting the three class-slot env vars, with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY retained for backwards compatibility

The cutover has no cross-provider fallback and fails closed on Bedrock outage, so safety net (kill-switch runbook, client-error alarm, VOTER_ERROR proof on Anthropic path) must be established before the model flip takes effect
Every LLM call post-cutover must reach a Bedrock inference profile, with zero direct-Anthropic calls, verified via per-call usage log tally
The per-pass model split must be preserved post-cutover (Pass-1 on frontier/opus, Pass-2/Pass-4 on standard/sonnet) and validated against real production reviews
